name: Lactic acid
what_it_is: The acid that makes curd and yoghurt taste sour. It forms naturally when milk ferments.
why_its_added: Adds a sour taste and makes conditions harder for bacteria.

india.note: Permitted at GMP level - used as needed, no fixed numeric cap in the categories found.

usa.note: Generally Recognised As Safe (GRAS) for direct addition to food (21 CFR 184.1061)

means: No single-serving limit has been found for this substance. That is not the same as there being no risk from one large serving - it means nobody has published a number.

people_reports.rule: Reports are shown as reports. We count them. We never turn them into a health claim, and we never let them change the sourced facts above.

india_limits.food_category: Sterilized and UHT creams, whipping and whipped creams, and reduced fat creams (plain)
Dried pastas and noodles and like products
